content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-explained-digital-4|Digital Product]] creators face significant hurdles in receiving payments. The infrastructure you need is not just a workaround; it's a robust, sovereign solution. By using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-what-actually-16|nowpayments]] with Cloudflare Workers, you can establish a reliable payment system that operates independently of these conventional platforms. This guide will walk you through the deployment process to ensure you can receive crypto payments seamlessly, allowing you to focus on growing your digital product offerings.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processors impose restrictions that hinder digital creators in various regions. NOWPayments offers a solution that empowers you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on networks like Tron and Solana, which have low transaction fees. By leveraging Cloudflare Workers for your backend logic, you create an automated system that ensures timely payment processing without relying on third-party platforms, thus avoiding delays associated with payout systems like Gumroad.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-complete-14|COREMERCH guide to deploying]] your NOWPayments setup with Cloudflare Workers, ensure you have a few essential components in place. You will need a Cloudflare account to utilize Cloudflare Workers, a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing, and a Supabase account for order storage. Additionally, familiarize yourself with using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your storefront and have your digital products ready for upload. This preparation will streamline your deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by configuring your NOWPayments account to generate API keys. Integrate these keys into your Cloudflare Worker script, allowing it to handle payment confirmations. Next, set up your file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for efficient product delivery. Ensure your webhook configuration with NOWPayments is correctly set to trigger upon payment confirmation, creating a smooth transaction flow that minimizes delays.
Leverage low-cost transactions on Tron and Solana for your payments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Publish your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site, showcasing your digital products. Test your payment system by making a small transaction using USDT on the Tron or Solana network, both of which offer low fees under $0.10. Monitor the payment confirmation process through your Cloudflare Worker, ensuring that your system responds correctly and delivers the purchased product automatically once the payment is confirmed.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing your first transaction, explore ways to scale your operations. You can add more products to your storefront, utilize Supabase to manage customer data effectively, and enhance your marketing strategies to reach a broader audience. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and improved order management capabilities. This will ensure your infrastructure remains robust as you grow.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable and supports competitive local currency rates.
Your infrastructure remains yours—no subscriptions, no dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to streamline their payment processing, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive solution that integrates seamlessly with NOWPayments. This setup will allow you to handle multiple products and ensure your digital storefront is operational. Explore more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up a self-custody wallet first — Trust Wallet or MetaMask for USDT and other coins, with the private keys stored securely and backed up. Create a NOWPayments account and configure your wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept — start with USDT on Tron and Bitcoin. Set up a P2P exchange account in your country before you need it — Binance P2P, a local exchange, or both. Deploy your stack with NOWPayments configured and the webhook endpoint set. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm USDT arrives in your wallet within the expected confirmation time. Practice a test P2P conversion with a small amount to confirm you know the process end-to-end. When your first real sale arrives, verify it in the database, confirm delivery completed, then convert to local currency through your P2P exchange.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Set up a NOWPayments account to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. Integrate it with Cloudflare Workers for automatic payment processing, enabling you to manage payments effectively without relying on traditional platforms.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?

USDT transactions on Tron or Solana typically complete in under a minute. This is significantly faster than PayPal, which can experience delays due to verification processes, making crypto a superior option for immediate payments.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?

Creators can convert Bitcoin to naira through peer-to-peer exchanges like Binance or Patricia. These platforms allow for direct conversions, often providing competitive rates and quicker access to local currency, facilitating smoother transactions.
What are the transaction fees for using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% on transactions, making it a cost-effective solution for digital creators. This fee structure is significantly lower than traditional payment processors, allowing you to retain more revenue.
Can I use any cryptocurrency with NOWPayments?

Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, providing flexibility in payment options for your customers. This range includes popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT, accommodating diverse customer preferences.
